entry.title: Honduras planerar enormt fängelse – ska förhindra gängkriminalitet
entry.summary:

entry.title: Floderus och Azizi har landat i Sverige – Djalali kvar i iranskt fängelse
entry.summary:
• Efter ett utbyte via Oman ska Johan Floderus och Saeed Azizi utväxlats mot Hamid Noury som dömt grovt folkrättsbrott. De båda landade på Arlanda klockan 21:20 på lördagskvällen.

  • Statsminister Ulf Kristersson höll strax därefter en presskonferens tillsammans med justitieminister Gunnar Strömmer och utrikesminister Tobias Billström.

  • Samtidigt som Johan Floderus och Saeed Azizi är påväg hem till Sverige, efter en fångutväxling, sitter forskaren Ahmadreza Djalali kvar i fängelset i Iran. Iran har enligt regeringen inte velat diskutera en fångutväxling när de gäller Djalali, enligt svenska regeringskällor.

entry.title: Webb finds most distant known galaxy
entry.summary:
Image:
Using the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope, scientists have found a record-breaking galaxy observed only 290 million years after the Big Bang. Over the last two years, scientists have used the NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope to explore what astronomers refer to as cosmic dawn – the period in the first few hundred million years after the Big Bang where the first galaxies were born. These galaxies provide vital insight into the ways in which the gas, stars, and black holes were changing when the Universe was very young. In October 2023 and January 2024, an international team of astronomers used Webb to observe galaxies as part of the JWST Advanced Deep Extragalactic Survey (JADES) programme. Mars’s surface is covered in all manner of scratches and scars. Its many marks include the fingernail scratches of Tantalus Fossae, the colossal canyon system of Valles Marineris, the oddly orderly ridges of Angustus Labyrinthus, and the fascinating features captured in today’s video release from Mars Express: the cat scratches of Nili Fossae. Nili Fossae comprises parallel trenches hundreds of metres deep and several hundred kilometres long, stretching out along the eastern edge of a massive impact crater named Isidis Planitia. entry.title: Switching It Up With HTML’s Latest Control
